------------------------------ MODULE W4Od12m7p2t4 ------------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Total, MaxCap

Agents == {"tech_a", "tech_b"}
NoRead == 0 - 1

VARIABLES avail, reserved, issued, expected, cap

vars == <<avail, reserved, issued, expected, cap>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ avail \in 0..Total
    /\ reserved \in 0..Total
    /\ issued \in 0..Total
    /\ expected \in [Agents -> (0..Total) \union {NoRead}]
    /\ cap \in 0..MaxCap

Init ==
    /\ avail = Total
    /\ reserved = 0
    /\ issued = 0
    /\ expected = [p \in Agents |-> NoRead]
    /\ cap = MaxCap

\* A technician snapshots the available-units register before attempting a swap.
SnapshotRegister(p) ==
    /\ expected[p] = NoRead
    /\ avail > 0
    /\ expected' = [expected EXCEPT ![p] = avail]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<avail, reserved, issued, cap>>

\* Compare-and-swap: the register still matches the snapshot, so claim one unit.
ClaimUnit(p) ==
    /\ expected[p] # NoRead
    /\ avail = expected[p]
    /\ avail > 0
    /\ reserved < cap
    /\ avail' = avail - 1
    /\ reserved' = reserved + 1
    /\ expected' = [expected EXCEPT ![p] = NoRead]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<issued, cap>>

\* The register moved under us between snapshot and swap; abandon and retry later.
SwapAborted(p) ==
    /\ expected[p] # NoRead
    /\ avail # expected[p]
    /\ expected' = [expected EXCEPT ![p] = NoRead]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<avail, reserved, issued, cap>>

\* A reserved unit is transfused into a patient; it leaves the shelf permanently.
Transfuse ==
    /\ reserved > 0
    /\ reserved' = reserved - 1
    /\ issued' = issued + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<avail, expected, cap>>

\* The fridge's reservation capacity is re-provisioned at runtime, never below
\* what is already reserved.
Reprovision ==
    /\ \E c \in 0..MaxCap :
        /\ c >= reserved
        /\ cap' = c
    /\ UNCHANGED <<avail, reserved, issued, expected>>

Next ==
    \/ \E p \in Agents : SnapshotRegister(p)
    \/ \E p \in Agents : ClaimUnit(p)
    \/ \E p \in Agents : SwapAborted(p)
    \/ Transfuse
    \/ Reprovision

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Conservation: every unit of blood is on the shelf, reserved, or already
\* transfused -- none is ever created or lost by the tracker.
Conserved == avail + reserved + issued = Total

=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Total = 3
    MaxCap = 2
SPECIFICATION Spec
INVARIANT Conserved
nl:
A regional blood-bank inventory tracker guards a single fridge whose stock is
counted by one shared "available units" register. Two technicians work the
fridge concurrently, and to avoid clobbering each other's counts they update
the register with a compare-and-swap discipline rather than a plain write.

A technician first snapshots the register, reading the current available count.
When it is time to actually claim a unit, the technician performs a
compare-and-swap: only if the register still equals the snapshotted value is the
swap allowed to go through, decrementing available by one and moving that unit
into the reserved pool. If the other technician got there first and the register
no longer matches the snapshot, the swap is aborted and the technician must take
a fresh snapshot before trying again. A reserved unit is eventually transfused
into a patient, at which point it leaves the reserved pool and is counted as
issued -- it does not return to the shelf.

The fridge's reservation capacity is not fixed: hospital operations re-provision
it at runtime as coolers are added or pulled for maintenance, but it is never
lowered below the number of units already reserved.

The complete set of actions is: snapshot the register, claim a unit via a
successful compare-and-swap, abort a swap whose snapshot went stale, transfuse a
reserved unit, and re-provision the reservation capacity.

SAFETY PROPERTY: at every moment the number of units available on the shelf plus
the number reserved plus the number already transfused equals the fixed total,
so the tracker never creates or loses a unit of blood.

------------------------------ MODULE W4Od9m4p1t1 ------------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Feeders, MaxQueue, MaxVersion

VARIABLES shedTotal, committed, queue, version, dropped

vars == <<shedTotal, committed, queue, version, dropped>>

\* Each feeder's shed weight is simply its numeric id.
Weight(f) == f

RECURSIVE SumOf(_)
SumOf(S) ==
    IF S = {} THEN 0
    ELSE LET x == CHOOSE y \in S : TRUE IN Weight(x) + SumOf(S \ {x})

TypeOK ==
    /\ shedTotal \in 0..(SumOf(Feeders))
    /\ committed \in SUBSET Feeders
    /\ queue \in SUBSET (Feeders \X (0..(MaxVersion - 1)))
    /\ version \in 0..(MaxVersion - 1)
    /\ dropped \in SUBSET Feeders

Init ==
    /\ shedTotal = 0
    /\ committed = {}
    /\ queue = {}
    /\ version = 0
    /\ dropped = {}

\* A dispatcher enqueues a shed request for a feeder, tagging it with the record
\* version it observed. Backpressure blocks the enqueue when the queue is full.
Submit(f) ==
    /\ f \notin committed
    /\ ~ \E e \in queue : e[1] = f
    /\ Cardinality(queue) < MaxQueue
    /\ queue' = queue \union {<<f, version>>}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<shedTotal, committed, version, dropped>>

\* Requests may be serviced in any order. A request whose observed version still
\* matches the shared record commits its shed contribution exactly once.
Commit(e) ==
    /\ e \in queue
    /\ e[2] = version
    /\ e[1] \notin committed
    /\ shedTotal' = shedTotal + Weight(e[1])
    /\ committed' = committed \union {e[1]}
    /\ version' = (version + 1) % MaxVersion
    /\ queue' = queue \ {e}
    /\ UNCHANGED dropped

\* A request whose observed version is stale (another commit slipped ahead of it)
\* is discarded instead of overwriting the record; the feeder must resubmit.
Reject(e) ==
    /\ e \in queue
    /\ e[2] # version
    /\ queue' = queue \ {e}
    /\ dropped' = dropped \union {e[1]}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<shedTotal, committed, version>>

\* A dropped feeder is allowed to try again from scratch.
Resubmit(f) ==
    /\ f \in dropped
    /\ f \notin committed
    /\ dropped' = dropped \ {f}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<shedTotal, committed, queue, version>>

\* When capacity recovers, a committed feeder's load is restored: its shed weight
\* is subtracted back out of the running total and the record version advances.
Restore(f) ==
    /\ f \in committed
    /\ shedTotal' = shedTotal - Weight(f)
    /\ committed' = committed \ {f}
    /\ version' = (version + 1) % MaxVersion
    /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, dropped>>

Next ==
    \/ \E f \in Feeders : Submit(f)
    \/ \E e \in queue : Commit(e)
    \/ \E e \in queue : Reject(e)
    \/ \E f \in Feeders : Resubmit(f)
    \/ \E f \in Feeders : Restore(f)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* No lost updates: the shared shed-total register always equals the exact sum of
\* the shed weights of the feeders that have committed -- no committed update is
\* dropped and none is applied twice under reordering.
NoLostUpdate == shedTotal = SumOf(committed)

=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Feeders = {1, 2, 3}
    MaxQueue = 2
    MaxVersion = 3
SPECIFICATION Spec
INVARIANT NoLostUpdate
nl:
A power-grid load shedder keeps a single shared record, the total megawattage
currently being shed across the network. Feeder controllers each want to add
their feeder's shed contribution to that record. Because several controllers act
concurrently and their requests can be delivered to the dispatcher in any order,
the shedder uses a version-stamped, optimistic update discipline so that no
committed update is ever lost or double-applied.

A controller submits a shed request for its feeder, tagging the request with the
version number of the shared record it observed at submission time. The
dispatch queue is bounded: when it is already full the submission is refused by
backpressure and the controller waits. Queued requests are not serviced in
arrival order -- any pending request may be picked next. When a request is
serviced, the dispatcher checks its tagged version against the record's current
version; if they still match, the feeder's shed weight is added to the running
total, the feeder is marked committed, and the record's version advances. If the
tagged version is stale because another request committed ahead of it, the
request is dropped rather than allowed to clobber the record, and the feeder is
free to resubmit from scratch.

When network capacity recovers, a committed feeder's load can be restored: its
shed weight is subtracted back out of the shared total and the record version
advances again.

The full set of actions is: submit a version-tagged request under backpressure,
commit a request whose version still matches, reject a request whose version has
gone stale, resubmit a previously dropped feeder, and restore a committed
feeder's load.

SAFETY PROPERTY: the shared shed-total register always equals exactly the sum of
the shed weights of the feeders that have committed, so no committed update is
ever lost or counted twice.

------------------------------ MODULE W4Od5m2p3t4 ------------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Players, NumSlots

Slots == 1..NumSlots
Free == "free"
NoSlot == 0
NoOne == "no_one"

VARIABLES owner, pstate, ptarget, locked, capacity

vars == <<owner, pstate, ptarget, locked, capacity>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ owner \in [Slots -> Players \union {Free}]
    /\ pstate \in [Players -> {"idle", "preparing", "prepared", "done"}]
    /\ ptarget \in [Players -> Slots \union {NoSlot}]
    /\ locked \in [Slots -> Players \union {NoOne}]
    /\ capacity \in 1..NumSlots

Init ==
    /\ owner = [s \in Slots |-> Free]
    /\ pstate = [p \in Players |-> "idle"]
    /\ ptarget = [p \in Players |-> NoSlot]
    /\ locked = [s \in Slots |-> NoOne]
    /\ capacity = NumSlots

\* A player opens a two-phase commit to claim a currently-active, free slot.
Begin(p, s) ==
    /\ pstate[p] = "idle"
    /\ s <= capacity
    /\ owner[s] = Free
    /\ pstate' = [pstate EXCEPT ![p] = "preparing"]
    /\ ptarget' = [ptarget EXCEPT ![p] = s]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, locked, capacity>>

\* Prepare phase: the slot manager grants the prepare lock if it is free.
Prepare(p) ==
    /\ pstate[p] = "preparing"
    /\ locked[ptarget[p]] = NoOne
    /\ locked' = [locked EXCEPT ![ptarget[p]] = p]
    /\ pstate' = [pstate EXCEPT ![p] = "prepared"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, ptarget, capacity>>

\* Abort: another player already holds the prepare lock, so back off and retry.
Abort(p) ==
    /\ pstate[p] = "preparing"
    /\ locked[ptarget[p]] # NoOne
    /\ pstate' = [pstate EXCEPT ![p] = "idle"]
    /\ ptarget' = [ptarget EXCEPT ![p] = NoSlot]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, locked, capacity>>

\* Commit phase: holding the prepare lock, write the authoritative allocation.
Commit(p) ==
    /\ pstate[p] = "prepared"
    /\ locked[ptarget[p]] = p
    /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![ptarget[p]] = p]
    /\ pstate' = [pstate EXCEPT ![p] = "done"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<ptarget, locked, capacity>>

\* A finished player leaves the lobby, freeing its slot and prepare lock.
Release(p) ==
    /\ pstate[p] = "done"
    /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![ptarget[p]] = Free]
    /\ locked' = [locked EXCEPT ![ptarget[p]] = NoOne]
    /\ pstate' = [pstate EXCEPT ![p] = "idle"]
    /\ ptarget' = [ptarget EXCEPT ![p] = NoSlot]
    /\ UNCHANGED capacity

\* The matchmaker resizes how many slots are active at runtime.
Reconfig ==
    /\ \E c \in 1..NumSlots : capacity' = c
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, pstate, ptarget, locked>>

Next ==
    \/ \E p \in Players, s \in Slots : Begin(p, s)
    \/ \E p \in Players : Prepare(p)
    \/ \E p \in Players : Abort(p)
    \/ \E p \in Players : Commit(p)
    \/ \E p \in Players : Release(p)
    \/ Reconfig

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* No double allocation: whenever a player treats its claim on a slot as
\* committed, the authoritative owner record agrees that same player owns it --
\* so no two players can both walk away owning one slot.
NoDoubleAlloc ==
    \A p \in Players :
        (pstate[p] = "done") => owner[ptarget[p]] = p

=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Players = {"pa", "pb"}
    NumSlots = 3
SPECIFICATION Spec
INVARIANT NoDoubleAlloc
nl:
A multiplayer game lobby matchmaker hands out numbered lobby slots to players.
Because several players try to grab slots at the same time, each allocation runs
as a two-phase commit against the slot managers so that a slot is never handed to
two players at once.

A player opens a transaction to claim a specific slot that is currently active
and free. In the prepare phase the slot's manager grants a prepare lock, but only
if no other player already holds that lock; if the lock is already taken the
player aborts and may retry a different slot later. Once a player holds the
prepare lock it enters the commit phase and writes the authoritative allocation
record naming itself as the slot's owner. A player that has finished playing
releases its slot, clearing both the owner record and the prepare lock so the
slot can be claimed again.

The number of slots that are active is not fixed: the matchmaker resizes the pool
at runtime, changing how many slots new claims may target, though it never evicts
a player that already owns a slot.

The full set of actions is: begin a claim on an active free slot, grant the
prepare lock, abort when the lock is already held, commit the authoritative
allocation while holding the lock, release a finished slot, and reconfigure the
active-slot count.

SAFETY PROPERTY: whenever a player regards its claim on a slot as committed, the
authoritative owner record names that same player as the slot's owner, so no two
players ever end up owning the same slot.

------------------------------ MODULE W4Od15m9p5t2 ------------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Instances, MaxEpoch, MaxPrice

NoPrice == 0 - 1
NoEpoch == 0 - 1

VARIABLES epoch, localEpoch, openPrice, openEpoch, bids

vars == <<epoch, localEpoch, openPrice, openEpoch, bids>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ epoch \in 0..MaxEpoch
    /\ localEpoch \in [Instances -> 0..MaxEpoch]
    /\ openPrice \in (0..MaxPrice) \union {NoPrice}
    /\ openEpoch \in (0..MaxEpoch) \union {NoEpoch}
    /\ bids \in [Instances -> 0..MaxPrice]

Init ==
    /\ epoch = 0
    /\ localEpoch = [i \in Instances |-> 0]
    /\ openPrice = NoPrice
    /\ openEpoch = NoEpoch
    /\ bids = [i \in Instances |-> 0]

\* The auction parameters are reconfigured under a new epoch number. This is only
\* possible before the book has been uncrossed; once open, the auction is frozen.
Reconfig ==
    /\ openPrice = NoPrice
    /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
    /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<localEpoch, openPrice, openEpoch, bids>>

\* A matching-engine instance adopts the current epoch's configuration.
Adopt(i) ==
    /\ localEpoch[i] # epoch
    /\ localEpoch' = [localEpoch EXCEPT ![i] = epoch]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, openPrice, openEpoch, bids>>

\* An instance quotes an indicative opening bid into the shared pool. Quoting
\* continues even after the open (ordinary continuous-session trading).
Quote(i, b) ==
    /\ b # bids[i]
    /\ bids' = [bids EXCEPT ![i] = b]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, localEpoch, openPrice, openEpoch>>

\* The irreversible opening print: an instance running the current epoch uncrosses
\* the book at its bid. This can fire at most once because it requires the print
\* to be unset, and after it fires no reconfiguration can advance the epoch.
Uncross(i) ==
    /\ openPrice = NoPrice
    /\ localEpoch[i] = epoch
    /\ openPrice' = bids[i]
    /\ openEpoch' = epoch
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, localEpoch, bids>>

Next ==
    \/ Reconfig
    \/ \E i \in Instances : Adopt(i)
    \/ \E i \in Instances, b \in 0..MaxPrice : Quote(i, b)
    \/ \E i \in Instances : Uncross(i)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Once the opening print exists it is pinned to the epoch it fired in: no epoch
\* reconfiguration can supersede it, so the irreversible open happens in exactly
\* one epoch and can never be redone under a fresh configuration.
OpenIsIrreversible ==
    (openPrice # NoPrice) => (openEpoch = epoch)

=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Instances = {"eng_x", "eng_y"}
    MaxEpoch = 3
    MaxPrice = 2
SPECIFICATION Spec
INVARIANT OpenIsIrreversible
nl:
A stock exchange runs an opening auction whose parameters are managed by
epoch-numbered reconfiguration: each time operations retunes the auction the
epoch counter advances, and only the current epoch's configuration is
authoritative. Two independent matching-engine instances share one common order
pool and either one may drive the auction.

Before the book is uncrossed, operations may reconfigure the auction, bumping the
epoch. Each instance adopts the current epoch's configuration when it notices the
epoch has moved. Instances continuously quote indicative opening bids into the
shared pool; quoting keeps happening throughout, including during ordinary
continuous trading after the open. The pivotal step is the opening print: an
instance whose adopted epoch matches the current epoch uncrosses the book at its
quoted bid. This print is irreversible -- it may only fire while no print yet
exists, and once it has fired the auction is frozen so that no further epoch
reconfiguration can occur.

The full set of actions is: reconfigure the auction under a new epoch (only
before the open), adopt the current epoch on an instance, quote a bid into the
shared pool, and perform the irreversible opening print.

SAFETY PROPERTY: once the opening print exists it is pinned to the epoch in which
it fired, so no later epoch reconfiguration can supersede it and the irreversible
open happens in exactly one epoch and can never be redone.

------------------------------ MODULE W4Od12m1p2t4 ------------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Total, MaxCap, RingSize

Nodes == 1..RingSize
NextOf(n) == (n % RingSize) + 1

VARIABLES token, stock, transit, capacity

vars == <<token, stock, transit, capacity>>

RECURSIVE SumFn(_, _)
SumFn(f, S) ==
    IF S = {} THEN 0
    ELSE LET x == CHOOSE y \in S : TRUE IN f[x] + SumFn(f, S \ {x})

TypeOK ==
    /\ token \in Nodes
    /\ stock \in [Nodes -> 0..Total]
    /\ transit \in 0..Total
    /\ capacity \in [Nodes -> 0..MaxCap]

Init ==
    /\ token = 1
    /\ stock = [n \in Nodes |-> IF n = 1 THEN Total ELSE 0]
    /\ transit = 0
    /\ capacity = [n \in Nodes |-> MaxCap]

\* The single access token circulates around the ring; only its holder may move
\* blood between a fridge and the courier network.
PassToken ==
    /\ token' = NextOf(token)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<stock, transit, capacity>>

\* The token holder dispatches one unit from its fridge into the courier network.
ShipOut(n) ==
    /\ token = n
    /\ stock[n] > 0
    /\ stock' = [stock EXCEPT ![n] = stock[n] - 1]
    /\ transit' = transit + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, capacity>>

\* The token holder receives one in-transit unit into its fridge, space allowing.
Receive(n) ==
    /\ token = n
    /\ transit > 0
    /\ stock[n] < capacity[n]
    /\ stock' = [stock EXCEPT ![n] = stock[n] + 1]
    /\ transit' = transit - 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, capacity>>

\* A fridge's storage capacity is re-rated at runtime (a cooler is added or pulled),
\* but never below what it currently holds.
Resize(n) ==
    /\ \E c \in 0..MaxCap :
        /\ c >= stock[n]
        /\ capacity' = [capacity EXCEPT ![n] = c]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, stock, transit>>

Next ==
    \/ PassToken
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : ShipOut(n)
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Receive(n)
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Resize(n)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Conservation: the blood held across all fridges plus the blood currently in
\* transit between them always equals the fixed total the network started with.
Conserved == SumFn(stock, Nodes) + transit = Total

=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Total = 3
    MaxCap = 3
    RingSize = 3
SPECIFICATION Spec
INVARIANT Conserved
nl:
A regional blood-bank network links several fridge nodes arranged in a ring, with
a single access token circulating around the ring. Only the node currently
holding the token is allowed to move blood between its fridge and the shared
courier network, which guarantees exclusive access and prevents two nodes from
disturbing the in-transit pool at once.

The token is passed hand to hand from each node to the next around the ring. When
a node holds the token it may dispatch a unit from its fridge into the courier
network, moving that unit from local stock into the in-transit pool. Equally, the
token holder may receive an in-transit unit into its fridge, provided the fridge
has spare space, moving that unit from the in-transit pool into local stock. A
fridge's storage capacity is re-rated at runtime as coolers are added or pulled
for service, but it is never re-rated below the amount the fridge already holds.

The full set of actions is: pass the token to the next node, ship a unit from the
token holder's fridge into transit, receive an in-transit unit into the token
holder's fridge, and resize a fridge's capacity.

SAFETY PROPERTY: at every moment the blood held across all fridges plus the blood
currently in transit between them equals the fixed total the network started
with, so no unit is ever created or lost.

------------------------------ MODULE W4Od1m1p2t3 ------------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Total, NumControllers

Controllers == 1..NumControllers
NextOf(c) == (c % NumControllers) + 1

VARIABLES token, pool, approaching, circling, stalled

vars == <<token, pool, approaching, circling, stalled>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ token \in Controllers
    /\ pool \in 0..Total
    /\ approaching \in 0..Total
    /\ circling \in 0..Total
    /\ stalled \in [Controllers -> BOOLEAN]

Init ==
    /\ token = 1
    /\ pool = Total
    /\ approaching = 0
    /\ circling = 0
    /\ stalled = [c \in Controllers |-> FALSE]

\* The allocation token holder issues a landing clearance: a credit leaves the
\* free pool and follows an aircraft onto final approach.
Clear ==
    /\ ~ stalled[token]
    /\ pool > 0
    /\ pool' = pool - 1
    /\ approaching' = approaching + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, circling, stalled>>

\* An aircraft on approach lands and its clearance credit returns to the pool.
Land ==
    /\ ~ stalled[token]
    /\ approaching > 0
    /\ approaching' = approaching - 1
    /\ pool' = pool + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, circling, stalled>>

\* The holder diverts an approaching aircraft into a holding pattern; its credit
\* moves into the circling set without being lost.
Hold ==
    /\ ~ stalled[token]
    /\ approaching > 0
    /\ approaching' = approaching - 1
    /\ circling' = circling + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, pool, stalled>>

\* A circling aircraft is brought back onto final approach.
Rejoin ==
    /\ ~ stalled[token]
    /\ circling > 0
    /\ circling' = circling - 1
    /\ approaching' = approaching + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, pool, stalled>>

\* A controller becomes temporarily slow (heavy workload) -- it is not failed and
\* loses nothing, but it must recover before acting or handing off.
Stall(c) ==
    /\ ~ stalled[c]
    /\ stalled' = [stalled EXCEPT ![c] = TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, pool, approaching, circling>>

Resume(c) ==
    /\ stalled[c]
    /\ stalled' = [stalled EXCEPT ![c] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, pool, approaching, circling>>

\* The token is passed to the next controller; a slow (stalled) holder must
\* recover first, so a slow participant delays the ring but never breaks it.
PassToken ==
    /\ ~ stalled[token]
    /\ token' = NextOf(token)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<pool, approaching, circling, stalled>>

Next ==
    \/ Clear
    \/ Land
    \/ Hold
    \/ Rejoin
    \/ \E c \in Controllers : Stall(c)
    \/ \E c \in Controllers : Resume(c)
    \/ PassToken

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Conservation: every landing-clearance credit is always accounted for in exactly
\* one of the three states -- free in the pool, following an approaching aircraft,
\* or with a circling aircraft -- so the allocator never invents or drops a credit.
Conserved == pool + approaching + circling = Total

=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Total = 3
    NumControllers = 3
SPECIFICATION Spec
INVARIANT Conserved
nl:
An air-traffic runway allocator manages a fixed number of landing-clearance
credits shared by a ring of controllers. A single allocation token circulates
around the ring, and only the controller holding the token may issue or complete
clearances, guaranteeing exclusive access to the shared credit pool. The system
tolerates a controller that is slow but not failed: a busy controller may stall,
during which it loses nothing and simply cannot act until it recovers.

When the token holder is not stalled it may issue a landing clearance, moving a
credit from the free pool to follow an aircraft onto final approach. An
approaching aircraft that lands returns its credit to the pool. The holder may
instead divert an approaching aircraft into a holding pattern, moving its credit
into the circling set, and may later bring a circling aircraft back onto final
approach. Any controller may become temporarily stalled and must later resume;
the token may only be passed to the next controller when the current holder is
not stalled, so a slow controller delays the ring but never breaks it.

The full set of actions is: clear an aircraft to land, land an approaching
aircraft, divert an aircraft into holding, rejoin a circling aircraft to
approach, stall a controller, resume a stalled controller, and pass the token.

SAFETY PROPERTY: at every moment every landing-clearance credit is accounted for
in exactly one of the three states -- free in the pool, following an approaching
aircraft, or with a circling aircraft -- so their total never changes.

spec_text:
------------------------------ MODULE W4Od16m9p4t4 ------------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Stations, MaxCap, MaxEpoch

NoAuth == 0 - 1

VARIABLES epoch, capacity, filled, auth

vars == <<epoch, capacity, filled, auth>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ epoch \in 0..MaxEpoch
    /\ capacity \in 0..MaxCap
    /\ filled \in 0..MaxCap
    /\ auth \in [Stations -> (0..MaxEpoch) \union {NoAuth}]

Init ==
    /\ epoch = 0
    /\ capacity = MaxCap
    /\ filled = 0
    /\ auth = [s \in Stations |-> NoAuth]

\* The dispenser is reconfigured under a new epoch, re-rating the bin capacity at
\* runtime. Capacity is never re-rated below what is already dispensed.
Reconfig ==
    /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
    /\ \E c \in 1..MaxCap :
        /\ c >= filled
        /\ capacity' = c
    /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<filled, auth>>

\* A station takes out a dispensing authorization stamped with the current epoch,
\* provided there currently appears to be room.
Authorize(s) ==
    /\ auth[s] = NoAuth
    /\ filled < capacity
    /\ auth' = [auth EXCEPT ![s] = epoch]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, capacity, filled>>

\* A station dispenses one unit, but only if its authorization is still current
\* for this epoch and there is genuinely room right now (re-checked at commit).
Fill(s) ==
    /\ auth[s] = epoch
    /\ filled < capacity
    /\ filled' = filled + 1
    /\ auth' = [auth EXCEPT ![s] = NoAuth]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, capacity>>

\* An authorization issued under a superseded epoch is void and is dropped; the
\* station must re-authorize against the new configuration.
Revalidate(s) ==
    /\ auth[s] # NoAuth
    /\ auth[s] # epoch
    /\ auth' = [auth EXCEPT ![s] = NoAuth]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, capacity, filled>>

\* A patient collects a dispensed unit, freeing one slot of bin capacity.
Collect ==
    /\ filled > 0
    /\ filled' = filled - 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, capacity, auth>>

Next ==
    \/ Reconfig
    \/ \E s \in Stations : Authorize(s)
    \/ \E s \in Stations : Fill(s)
    \/ \E s \in Stations : Revalidate(s)
    \/ Collect

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Bounded capacity: the number of units currently dispensed into the bins never
\* exceeds the bin capacity, even across a runtime capacity reconfiguration, since
\* a station authorized under a stale epoch must revalidate before it can dispense.
WithinCapacity == filled <= capacity

------------------------------ MODULE W4Od19m9p0t3 ------------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Patrons, MaxEpoch

NoOne == "no_one"
NoEpoch == 0 - 1

VARIABLES epoch, holder, pstate, reqEpoch

vars == <<epoch, holder, pstate, reqEpoch>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ epoch \in 0..MaxEpoch
    /\ holder \in Patrons \union {NoOne}
    /\ pstate \in [Patrons -> {"idle", "requesting", "using", "slow"}]
    /\ reqEpoch \in [Patrons -> (0..MaxEpoch) \union {NoEpoch}]

Init ==
    /\ epoch = 0
    /\ holder = NoOne
    /\ pstate = [p \in Patrons |-> "idle"]
    /\ reqEpoch = [p \in Patrons |-> NoEpoch]

\* The reservation policy is reconfigured under a new epoch; requests made under
\* the old policy no longer count.
Reconfig ==
    /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
    /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, pstate, reqEpoch>>

\* A patron requests the rare book, stamping the request with the current epoch.
Request(p) ==
    /\ pstate[p] = "idle"
    /\ pstate' = [pstate EXCEPT ![p] = "requesting"]
    /\ reqEpoch' = [reqEpoch EXCEPT ![p] = epoch]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, holder>>

\* The desk grants the book to a requester whose request is current, but only when
\* nobody currently holds it -- this is the exclusive handoff.
Grant(p) ==
    /\ pstate[p] = "requesting"
    /\ reqEpoch[p] = epoch
    /\ holder = NoOne
    /\ holder' = p
    /\ pstate' = [pstate EXCEPT ![p] = "using"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, reqEpoch>>

\* A request left stale by a reconfiguration is voided; the patron returns to idle.
Voided(p) ==
    /\ pstate[p] = "requesting"
    /\ reqEpoch[p] # epoch
    /\ pstate' = [pstate EXCEPT ![p] = "idle"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, holder, reqEpoch>>

\* The holder is slow to return the book (still reading) -- slow, not failed. It
\* keeps exclusive hold and must eventually return.
SlowHold(p) ==
    /\ pstate[p] = "using"
    /\ pstate' = [pstate EXCEPT ![p] = "slow"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, holder, reqEpoch>>

\* The holder returns the book, releasing exclusive access.
Return(p) ==
    /\ pstate[p] \in {"using", "slow"}
    /\ holder = p
    /\ holder' = NoOne
    /\ pstate' = [pstate EXCEPT ![p] = "idle"]
    /\ reqEpoch' = [reqEpoch EXCEPT ![p] = NoEpoch]
    /\ UNCHANGED epoch

Next ==
    \/ Reconfig
    \/ \E p \in Patrons : Request(p)
    \/ \E p \in Patrons : Grant(p)
    \/ \E p \in Patrons : Voided(p)
    \/ \E p \in Patrons : SlowHold(p)
    \/ \E p \in Patrons : Return(p)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Mutual exclusion: any patron actually in possession of the rare book (whether
\* actively reading or merely slow to return it) is recorded as the sole holder,
\* so two patrons can never hold the one book at the same time.
Exclusive ==
    \A p \in Patrons : (pstate[p] \in {"using", "slow"}) => (holder = p)

critical resource that only one patron may hold at a time. The reservation policy

under the current epoch. The system tolerates a patron who is slow but not
failed: a patron actively reading may become slow to return the book, keeping
exclusive hold, but is never treated as having lost it.

when nobody currently holds it, performing the exclusive handoff. A request left
stale by a reconfiguration is voided and the patron returns to idle. Once holding

releasing exclusive access.

book, grant the book to a current requester when free, void a stale request, mark
the holder as slow, and return the book.

reading or merely slow to return it -- is recorded as the book's sole holder, so
two patrons can never hold the one book at the same time.

------------------------------ MODULE W4Od9m2p1t5 ------------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Regions, MaxVal

VARIABLES master, copy, txPhase, txValue, voted

vars == <<master, copy, txPhase, txValue, voted>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ master \in 0..MaxVal
    /\ copy \in [Regions -> 0..MaxVal]
    /\ txPhase \in {"idle", "preparing", "committing"}
    /\ txValue \in 0..MaxVal
    /\ voted \in SUBSET Regions

Init ==
    /\ master = 0
    /\ copy = [r \in Regions |-> 0]
    /\ txPhase = "idle"
    /\ txValue = 0
    /\ voted = {}

\* The coordinator proposes a new shed-schedule value, opening a two-phase commit.
Propose(v) ==
    /\ txPhase = "idle"
    /\ txPhase' = "preparing"
    /\ txValue' = v
    /\ voted' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<master, copy>>

\* A region votes to prepare the pending transaction.
Prepare(r) ==
    /\ txPhase = "preparing"
    /\ r \notin voted
    /\ voted' = voted \union {r}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<master, copy, txPhase, txValue>>

\* With every region prepared, the transaction commits: the authoritative record
\* takes the new value and the protocol moves to propagating it.
Commit ==
    /\ txPhase = "preparing"
    /\ voted = Regions
    /\ master' = txValue
    /\ txPhase' = "committing"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<copy, txValue, voted>>

\* Each region applies the committed value into its local copy.
Apply(r) ==
    /\ txPhase = "committing"
    /\ copy[r] # master
    /\ copy' = [copy EXCEPT ![r] = master]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<master, txPhase, txValue, voted>>

\* Once every region has applied the committed value, the transaction settles.
Finish ==
    /\ txPhase = "committing"
    /\ \A r \in Regions : copy[r] = master
    /\ txPhase' = "idle"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<master, copy, txValue, voted>>

\* The coordinator aborts a prepared transaction; the record is left untouched.
Abort ==
    /\ txPhase = "preparing"
    /\ txPhase' = "idle"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<master, copy, txValue, voted>>

\* A privileged grid admin force-completes a stuck propagation, pushing the
\* committed value into every lagging region at once and settling the transaction.
AdminOverride ==
    /\ txPhase = "committing"
    /\ copy' = [r \in Regions |-> master]
    /\ txPhase' = "idle"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<master, txValue, voted>>

Next ==
    \/ \E v \in 0..MaxVal : Propose(v)
    \/ \E r \in Regions : Prepare(r)
    \/ Commit
    \/ \E r \in Regions : Apply(r)
    \/ Finish
    \/ Abort
    \/ AdminOverride

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* No lost updates: whenever the protocol is settled (idle), every region's local
\* copy reflects the authoritative committed record -- no committed update is left
\* dropped at a region once its transaction completes.
SettledCoherent ==
    (txPhase = "idle") => (\A r \in Regions : copy[r] = master)

=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Regions = {"north", "south"}
    MaxVal = 2
SPECIFICATION Spec
INVARIANT SettledCoherent
nl:
A power-grid load shedder keeps a shared shed-schedule record replicated across
regional controllers. Updates to the record are applied with a two-phase commit
so that a committed update is never lost or left half-applied at some region.

The coordinator proposes a new shed-schedule value, opening a transaction. Each
region votes to prepare it. Once every region has prepared, the transaction
commits: the authoritative record takes the new value and the protocol moves into
propagation, where each region applies the committed value into its own local
copy. When every region has applied it, the transaction settles. A prepared
transaction may instead be aborted by the coordinator, leaving the record
untouched. Finally, a privileged grid administrator can override a stuck
propagation, force-pushing the committed value into every lagging region at once
and settling the transaction immediately.

The full set of actions is: propose a new value, prepare a region, commit once all
regions have prepared, apply the committed value at a region, finish once all have
applied, abort a prepared transaction, and perform a privileged admin override of
a stuck propagation.

SAFETY PROPERTY: whenever the protocol is settled and idle, every region's local
copy reflects the authoritative committed record, so no committed update is ever
left dropped at a region once its transaction has completed.

------------------------------ MODULE W4Od14m1p6t2 ------------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Drones, Sectors, MaxGen

NoOne == 0
NoGen == 0 - 1

VARIABLES tokenGen, holder, grant, claimed

vars == <<tokenGen, holder, grant, claimed>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ tokenGen \in 0..MaxGen
    /\ holder \in Drones
    /\ grant \in [Drones -> (0..MaxGen) \union {NoGen}]
    /\ claimed \in [Sectors -> Drones \union {NoOne}]

Init ==
    /\ tokenGen = 0
    /\ holder = CHOOSE d \in Drones : TRUE
    /\ grant = [d \in Drones |-> IF d = (CHOOSE e \in Drones : TRUE) THEN 0 ELSE NoGen]
    /\ claimed = [s \in Sectors |-> NoOne]

\* Either control instance reissues the surveillance token to a chosen drone under
\* a brand-new generation, which invalidates every previously cached grant.
Reissue(d) ==
    /\ tokenGen < MaxGen
    /\ tokenGen' = tokenGen + 1
    /\ holder' = d
    /\ grant' = [e \in Drones |-> IF e = d THEN tokenGen + 1 ELSE NoGen]
    /\ UNCHANGED claimed

\* Either instance hands the token from the current holder to another drone under
\* the same generation -- the normal ring circulation.
Handoff(d) ==
    /\ d # holder
    /\ grant[holder] = tokenGen
    /\ holder' = d
    /\ grant' = [grant EXCEPT ![holder] = NoGen, ![d] = tokenGen]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<tokenGen, claimed>>

\* A drone surveils a sector into the shared map -- permitted only while it holds a
\* current-generation grant (it is authorized and not stale).
Surveil(d, s) ==
    /\ grant[d] = tokenGen
    /\ claimed' = [claimed EXCEPT ![s] = d]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<tokenGen, holder, grant>>

\* A drone whose cached grant has been superseded discards it.
StaleDrop(d) ==
    /\ grant[d] # NoGen
    /\ grant[d] # tokenGen
    /\ grant' = [grant EXCEPT ![d] = NoGen]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<tokenGen, holder, claimed>>

\* A sector's coverage is cleared so it can be reassigned.
Clear(s) ==
    /\ claimed[s] # NoOne
    /\ claimed' = [claimed EXCEPT ![s] = NoOne]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<tokenGen, holder, grant>>

Next ==
    \/ \E d \in Drones : Reissue(d)
    \/ \E d \in Drones : Handoff(d)
    \/ \E d \in Drones, s \in Sectors : Surveil(d, s)
    \/ \E d \in Drones : StaleDrop(d)
    \/ \E s \in Sectors : Clear(s)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* No action by an unauthorized or stale participant: a drone holds a
\* current-generation grant if and only if it is the recorded token holder, so
\* only the single authorized, non-stale drone can ever write to the shared map.
Authorized ==
    \A d \in Drones : (grant[d] = tokenGen) <=> (d = holder)

=============================================================================
nl:
A wildfire drone surveillance swarm is driven by two independent control
instances that share one common sector-coverage map and one circulating
surveillance token. The drones are drawn from both instances but there is a
single token: only the drone currently holding a current-generation token grant
is authorized to write coverage into the shared map, so no unauthorized or stale
drone can ever touch it.

Either control instance may reissue the token to a chosen drone under a
brand-new generation number; doing so invalidates every previously cached grant,
making all other drones stale. Either instance may also hand the token from the
current holder to another drone under the same generation -- the normal ring
circulation. A drone surveils a sector into the shared map only while it holds a
grant whose generation matches the current one. A drone whose cached grant has
been superseded by a reissue discards it. Coverage of a sector may be cleared so
the sector can be reassigned.

The full set of actions is: reissue the token under a new generation, hand the
token to another drone under the same generation, surveil a sector while holding
a current grant, drop a superseded grant, and clear a sector's coverage.

SAFETY PROPERTY: a drone holds a current-generation token grant if and only if it
is the recorded token holder, so only the single authorized, non-stale drone can
ever write to the shared coverage map.

------------------------------ MODULE W4Od9m3p6t0 ------------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Controllers, MaxTerm

NoOne == "no_one"

VARIABLES term, leader, cstate, cterm, shedActive

vars == <<term, leader, cstate, cterm, shedActive>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ term \in 0..MaxTerm
    /\ leader \in Controllers \union {NoOne}
    /\ cstate \in [Controllers -> {"follower", "leader", "crashed"}]
    /\ cterm \in [Controllers -> 0..MaxTerm]
    /\ shedActive \in BOOLEAN

Init ==
    /\ term = 0
    /\ leader = NoOne
    /\ cstate = [c \in Controllers |-> "follower"]
    /\ cterm = [c \in Controllers |-> 0]
    /\ shedActive = FALSE

\* A live controller wins an election under a fresh, higher term and becomes the
\* leader. Any previous leader is thereby left stale (its term is now behind).
Elect(c) ==
    /\ cstate[c] # "crashed"
    /\ term < MaxTerm
    /\ term' = term + 1
    /\ leader' = c
    /\ cstate' = [cstate EXCEPT ![c] = "leader"]
    /\ cterm' = [cterm EXCEPT ![c] = term + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED shedActive

\* Only a leader whose term is the current term may drive load shedding.
Shed(c) ==
    /\ cstate[c] = "leader"
    /\ cterm[c] = term
    /\ shedActive' = ~ shedActive
    /\ UNCHANGED <<term, leader, cstate, cterm>>

\* A single controller may crash silently. If it was the leader, the leader
\* pointer is cleared, triggering a later failover election.
Crash(c) ==
    /\ \A x \in Controllers : cstate[x] # "crashed"
    /\ cstate' = [cstate EXCEPT ![c] = "crashed"]
    /\ leader' = IF leader = c THEN NoOne ELSE leader
    /\ UNCHANGED <<term, cterm, shedActive>>

\* A crashed controller recovers as a follower.
Recover(c) ==
    /\ cstate[c] = "crashed"
    /\ cstate' = [cstate EXCEPT ![c] = "follower"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<term, leader, cterm, shedActive>>

\* A stale leader (one still calling itself leader but on an old term) steps down.
StepDown(c) ==
    /\ cstate[c] = "leader"
    /\ cterm[c] # term
    /\ cstate' = [cstate EXCEPT ![c] = "follower"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<term, leader, cterm, shedActive>>

Next ==
    \/ \E c \in Controllers : Elect(c)
    \/ \E c \in Controllers : Shed(c)
    \/ \E c \in Controllers : Crash(c)
    \/ \E c \in Controllers : Recover(c)
    \/ \E c \in Controllers : StepDown(c)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* No action by an unauthorized or stale participant: whenever a leader is
\* recorded, that controller genuinely regards itself as leader and its term is the
\* current term -- so neither a deposed stale leader nor a crashed controller can
\* be the authority that drives shedding.
LeaderAuthorized ==
    (leader # NoOne) => (cstate[leader] = "leader" /\ cterm[leader] = term)

=============================================================================

CONSTANTS
    Controllers = {"a", "b", "c"}
    MaxTerm = 2
SPECIFICATION Spec
INVARIANT LeaderAuthorized
nl:
A power-grid load shedder is coordinated by a single leader elected among several
controllers, with failover when the leader is lost. Load shedding is a privileged
action that only the genuine current-term leader may drive, so that neither a
deposed stale leader nor a crashed controller can ever act as the authority.

A live controller wins an election under a fresh, higher term and becomes the
leader; any previous leader is thereby left stale because its term now trails the
current term. Only a controller that regards itself as leader and whose term is
the current term may toggle load shedding on or off. A single controller may
crash silently at a time; if the crashed controller was the leader, the leader
pointer is cleared so a failover election can raise a new leader. A crashed
controller may later recover as a follower, and a stale leader that is still
calling itself leader on an old term steps down to follower.

The full set of actions is: elect a live controller as leader under a new term,
shed load as the current-term leader, crash a controller silently, recover a
crashed controller, and step down a stale leader.

SAFETY PROPERTY: whenever a leader is recorded, that controller genuinely regards
itself as the leader and its term equals the current term, so no stale or crashed
participant is ever the authority that drives shedding.

------------------------------ MODULE W4Od18m2p3t5 ------------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Doors, Users

NoOne == "no_one"

VARIABLES owner, lockedFor, phase, engaged

vars == <<owner, lockedFor, phase, engaged>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ owner \in [Doors -> Users \union {NoOne}]
    /\ lockedFor \in [Doors -> Users \union {NoOne}]
    /\ phase \in [Doors -> {"idle", "preparing", "prepared"}]
    /\ engaged \in [Doors -> BOOLEAN]

Init ==
    /\ owner = [d \in Doors |-> NoOne]
    /\ lockedFor = [d \in Doors |-> NoOne]
    /\ phase = [d \in Doors |-> "idle"]
    /\ engaged = [d \in Doors |-> FALSE]

\* The hub proposes granting a door to a user, opening a two-phase commit and
\* tentatively earmarking the door for that user.
Propose(d, u) ==
    /\ phase[d] = "idle"
    /\ owner[d] = NoOne
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![d] = "preparing"]
    /\ lockedFor' = [lockedFor EXCEPT ![d] = u]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, engaged>>

\* The door manager votes to prepare only if the door is not already owned.
Vote(d) ==
    /\ phase[d] = "preparing"
    /\ owner[d] = NoOne
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![d] = "prepared"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, lockedFor, engaged>>

\* If the door turns out already owned, the door manager votes no and the
\* transaction aborts, dropping the earmark.
VoteAbort(d) ==
    /\ phase[d] = "preparing"
    /\ owner[d] # NoOne
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![d] = "idle"]
    /\ lockedFor' = [lockedFor EXCEPT ![d] = NoOne]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, engaged>>

\* Commit installs the earmarked user as the door's owner and clears the earmark.
Commit(d) ==
    /\ phase[d] = "prepared"
    /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![d] = lockedFor[d]]
    /\ lockedFor' = [lockedFor EXCEPT ![d] = NoOne]
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![d] = "idle"]
    /\ UNCHANGED engaged

\* The owner throws or releases the physical deadbolt.
Engage(d) ==
    /\ owner[d] # NoOne
    /\ engaged' = [engaged EXCEPT ![d] = ~ engaged[d]]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, lockedFor, phase>>

\* The owner relinquishes the door, first disengaging the bolt.
Relinquish(d) ==
    /\ owner[d] # NoOne
    /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![d] = NoOne]
    /\ engaged' = [engaged EXCEPT ![d] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<lockedFor, phase>>

\* A privileged admin force-assigns a door to a user, clearing any pending
\* earmark and transaction so no conflicting claim can linger.
AdminOverride(d, u) ==
    /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![d] = u]
    /\ lockedFor' = [lockedFor EXCEPT ![d] = NoOne]
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![d] = "idle"]
    /\ UNCHANGED engaged

Next ==
    \/ \E d \in Doors, u \in Users : Propose(d, u)
    \/ \E d \in Doors : Vote(d)
    \/ \E d \in Doors : VoteAbort(d)
    \/ \E d \in Doors : Commit(d)
    \/ \E d \in Doors : Engage(d)
    \/ \E d \in Doors : Relinquish(d)
    \/ \E d \in Doors, u \in Users : AdminOverride(d, u)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* No double allocation: a door is never simultaneously committed to one user and
\* earmarked by a pending transaction for a different user, so two users can never
\* both come to believe they hold the same door.
NoDoubleAlloc ==
    \A d \in Doors :
        ~ (owner[d] # NoOne /\ lockedFor[d] # NoOne /\ owner[d] # lockedFor[d])

=============================================================================
nl:
A smart-home door-lock network lets a hub grant control of each door to at most
one user session at a time. Granting a door runs as a two-phase commit between the
hub and the door's lock manager so that a door is never handed to two users at
once, even while an administrator can force reassignments.

The hub proposes granting a currently-free door to a user, opening a transaction
and tentatively earmarking the door for that user. The door manager then votes to prepare, but
only if the door is not already owned; if the door is already owned it votes no
and the transaction aborts, dropping the earmark. On commit, the earmarked user
becomes the door's owner and the earmark is cleared. An owner may throw or release
the physical deadbolt, and may relinquish the door entirely, first disengaging the
bolt. Finally, a privileged administrator may force-assign a door to a user,
clearing any pending earmark and transaction so that no conflicting claim can
linger behind the override.

The full set of actions is: propose a grant, vote to prepare when the door is
free, vote-abort when the door is already owned, commit the earmarked owner,
engage or release the deadbolt, relinquish a door, and perform a privileged admin
override.

SAFETY PROPERTY: a door is never simultaneously committed to one user and
earmarked by a pending transaction for a different user, so two users can never
both come to believe they hold the same door.

------------------------------ MODULE W4Od15m5p0t4 ------------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Engines, Voters

NoOne == "no_one"

VARIABLES holder, granted, campaigning, quorum

vars == <<holder, granted, campaigning, quorum>>

Tally(e) == Cardinality({v \in Voters : granted[v] = e})

TypeOK ==
    /\ holder \in Engines \union {NoOne}
    /\ granted \in [Voters -> Engines \union {NoOne}]
    /\ campaigning \in SUBSET Engines
    /\ quorum \in 2..Cardinality(Voters)

Init ==
    /\ holder = NoOne
    /\ granted = [v \in Voters |-> NoOne]
    /\ campaigning = {}
    /\ quorum = Cardinality(Voters)

\* A matching engine campaigns to become the opening-cross authority for the round.
Campaign(e) ==
    /\ holder = NoOne
    /\ e \notin campaigning
    /\ campaigning' = campaigning \union {e}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, granted, quorum>>

\* An exchange voter grants its single vote to one campaigning engine.
Grant(v, e) ==
    /\ holder = NoOne
    /\ e \in campaigning
    /\ granted[v] = NoOne
    /\ granted' = [granted EXCEPT ![v] = e]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, campaigning, quorum>>

\* An engine that has collected a quorum of grants seizes the exclusive authority.
Seize(e) ==
    /\ holder = NoOne
    /\ e \in campaigning
    /\ Tally(e) >= quorum
    /\ holder' = e
    /\ UNCHANGED <<granted, campaigning, quorum>>

\* The authority holder releases the role, resetting the election for a new round.
Release(e) ==
    /\ holder = e
    /\ holder' = NoOne
    /\ granted' = [v \in Voters |-> NoOne]
    /\ campaigning' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED quorum

\* Exchange operations re-rate the quorum threshold at runtime, but never below a
\* strict majority of the voters.
Resize(q) ==
    /\ quorum' = q
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, granted, campaigning>>

Next ==
    \/ \E e \in Engines : Campaign(e)
    \/ \E v \in Voters, e \in Engines : Grant(v, e)
    \/ \E e \in Engines : Seize(e)
    \/ \E e \in Engines : Release(e)
    \/ \E q \in 2..Cardinality(Voters) : Resize(q)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Mutual exclusion via quorum: no two distinct engines can ever simultaneously
\* hold a quorum of grants, so at most one engine can seize the opening-cross
\* authority in a round -- the critical resource is never held by two at once.
AtMostOneQuorum ==
    \A e1 \in Engines, e2 \in Engines :
        (e1 # e2) => ~ (Tally(e1) >= quorum /\ Tally(e2) >= quorum)

=============================================================================
nl:
A stock exchange opening auction elects, each round, a single matching engine to
be the opening-cross authority -- a critical resource that only one engine may
hold at a time. The election uses quorum voting: an engine must collect a quorum
of exchange voters' grants before it may seize the authority.

An engine campaigns to become the authority for the round. Each exchange voter
grants its single vote to one campaigning engine. An engine that has collected a
quorum of grants seizes the exclusive authority. When the holder releases the
role, the election resets for a new round, clearing all grants and campaigns.
Exchange operations may re-rate the quorum threshold at runtime as the panel of
voters changes, but the threshold is never re-rated below a strict majority of the
voters, so two engines can never both reach a quorum from the same voters.

The full set of actions is: campaign as an engine, grant a voter's single vote to
a campaigning engine, seize the authority once a quorum is reached, release the
authority to reset the round, and resize the quorum threshold.

SAFETY PROPERTY: no two distinct engines can ever simultaneously hold a quorum of
grants, so at most one engine can seize the opening-cross authority in a round and
the critical resource is never held by two engines at once.

------------------------------ MODULE W4Od7m6p6t2 ------------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Cranes, Bays, MaxMoves

NoOne == "no_one"

VARIABLES leasedTo, expired, busy, moves

vars == <<leasedTo, expired, busy, moves>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ leasedTo \in [Bays -> Cranes \union {NoOne}]
    /\ expired \in [Bays -> BOOLEAN]
    /\ busy \in [Bays -> BOOLEAN]
    /\ moves \in 0..MaxMoves

Init ==
    /\ leasedTo = [b \in Bays |-> NoOne]
    /\ expired = [b \in Bays |-> FALSE]
    /\ busy = [b \in Bays |-> FALSE]
    /\ moves = 0

\* A crane acquires the lease on a free bay, starting a fresh (unexpired) term.
Acquire(c, b) ==
    /\ leasedTo[b] = NoOne
    /\ leasedTo' = [leasedTo EXCEPT ![b] = c]
    /\ expired' = [expired EXCEPT ![b] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<busy, moves>>

\* The lessee begins a container lift -- allowed only while its lease is held and
\* not expired, and the bay is not already mid-lift.
Begin(c, b) ==
    /\ leasedTo[b] = c
    /\ ~ expired[b]
    /\ ~ busy[b]
    /\ busy' = [busy EXCEPT ![b] = TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leasedTo, expired, moves>>

\* A lift completes and is tallied into the shared yard move counter.
Complete(b) ==
    /\ busy[b]
    /\ busy' = [busy EXCEPT ![b] = FALSE]
    /\ moves' = (moves + 1) % (MaxMoves + 1)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leasedTo, expired>>

\* A lease lapses at its deadline, but only when no lift is in progress: an active
\* lift always finishes within the lease term.
Timeout(b) ==
    /\ leasedTo[b] # NoOne
    /\ ~ expired[b]
    /\ ~ busy[b]
    /\ expired' = [expired EXCEPT ![b] = TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leasedTo, busy, moves>>

\* An expired lease is reclaimed, freeing the bay.
Reclaim(b) ==
    /\ expired[b]
    /\ leasedTo' = [leasedTo EXCEPT ![b] = NoOne]
    /\ expired' = [expired EXCEPT ![b] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<busy, moves>>

\* A crane voluntarily vacates a bay it is not mid-lift on.
Vacate(c, b) ==
    /\ leasedTo[b] = c
    /\ ~ busy[b]
    /\ leasedTo' = [leasedTo EXCEPT ![b] = NoOne]
    /\ expired' = [expired EXCEPT ![b] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<busy, moves>>

Next ==
    \/ \E c \in Cranes, b \in Bays : Acquire(c, b)
    \/ \E c \in Cranes, b \in Bays : Begin(c, b)
    \/ \E b \in Bays : Complete(b)
    \/ \E b \in Bays : Timeout(b)
    \/ \E b \in Bays : Reclaim(b)
    \/ \E c \in Cranes, b \in Bays : Vacate(c, b)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* No action by an unauthorized or stale participant: any bay with a lift actually
\* in progress is held under a live, unexpired lease -- a crane whose lease has
\* lapsed or was never granted can never be the one operating the bay.
NoStaleAction ==
    \A b \in Bays : busy[b] => (leasedTo[b] # NoOne /\ ~ expired[b])

=============================================================================
nl:
A container-ship crane yard is run by two independent yard-controller instances
that share one pool of bays and one common tally of completed container moves.
Cranes take out lease-based ownership of a bay: a lease grants exclusive working
rights to that bay until it expires, and only a crane holding a live, unexpired
lease may operate the bay, so no unauthorized or stale crane can ever act.

A crane acquires the lease on a free bay, starting a fresh unexpired term. Holding
a valid lease, the crane begins a container lift, provided the bay is not already
mid-lift. A lift completes and is tallied into the shared yard-move counter. A
lease lapses at its deadline, but only when no lift is in progress, so an active
lift always finishes within its lease term. An expired lease is reclaimed, freeing
the bay, and a crane may also voluntarily vacate a bay it is not mid-lift on.

The full set of actions is: acquire a lease on a free bay, begin a lift under a
live lease, complete a lift into the shared move tally, time out a lease at its
deadline, reclaim an expired lease, and voluntarily vacate a bay.

SAFETY PROPERTY: any bay with a lift actually in progress is held under a live,
unexpired lease, so a crane whose lease has lapsed or was never granted can never
be the one operating the bay.

------------------------------ MODULE W4Od5m3p6t1 ------------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Nodes, MaxTerm, MaxApplied

NoOne == "no_one"

Messages == [src : Nodes, trm : 0..MaxTerm]

VARIABLES term, leader, inbox, applied, appliedTerm

vars == <<term, leader, inbox, applied, appliedTerm>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ term \in 0..MaxTerm
    /\ leader \in Nodes \union {NoOne}
    /\ inbox \in SUBSET Messages
    /\ applied \in 0..MaxApplied
    /\ appliedTerm \in 0..MaxTerm

Init ==
    /\ term = 0
    /\ leader = NoOne
    /\ inbox = {}
    /\ applied = 0
    /\ appliedTerm = 0

\* A matchmaker node wins a failover election under a fresh, higher term and
\* becomes leader; any messages still in flight from the old leader are now stale.
Elect(n) ==
    /\ term < MaxTerm
    /\ term' = term + 1
    /\ leader' = n
    /\ UNCHANGED <<inbox, applied, appliedTerm>>

\* The current leader emits a match-assignment message tagged with its own identity
\* and the current term. Messages queue up and may be delivered in any order.
Emit(n) ==
    /\ leader = n
    /\ inbox' = inbox \union {[src |-> n, trm |-> term]}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<term, leader, applied, appliedTerm>>

\* Any pending current-term message may be applied, in whatever order it surfaces.
Apply(m) ==
    /\ m \in inbox
    /\ m.trm = term
    /\ applied' = (applied + 1) % (MaxApplied + 1)
    /\ appliedTerm' = term
    /\ inbox' = inbox \ {m}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<term, leader>>

\* A message whose term is behind the current term is stale and is discarded rather
\* than acted upon, no matter how late it is delivered.
DropStale(m) ==
    /\ m \in inbox
    /\ m.trm < term
    /\ inbox' = inbox \ {m}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<term, leader, applied, appliedTerm>>

Next ==
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Elect(n)
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Emit(n)
    \/ \E m \in inbox : Apply(m)
    \/ \E m \in inbox : DropStale(m)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* No action by an unauthorized or stale participant: every in-flight message that
\* claims the current term was emitted by the current leader, so a message from a
\* deposed leader can never masquerade as a current-term instruction, even when it
\* arrives out of order.
CurrentFromLeader ==
    \A m \in inbox : (m.trm = term) => (m.src = leader)

=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Nodes = {"n1", "n2"}
    MaxTerm = 2
    MaxApplied = 2
SPECIFICATION Spec
INVARIANT CurrentFromLeader
nl:
A multiplayer game lobby matchmaker elects a single leader node to hand out match
assignments, with failover to a new leader when the old one is lost. Assignment
messages travel over a network that may reorder them, so the protocol tags every
message with the emitting node and the term under which it was sent, and treats a
message from a superseded leader as stale no matter how late it arrives.

A node wins a failover election under a fresh, higher term and becomes leader; any
messages still in flight from the previous leader now carry a term behind the
current one. The current leader emits match-assignment messages tagged with its
identity and the current term, and these queue up to be delivered in any order. A
pending message whose term matches the current term may be applied, in whatever
order it surfaces. A message whose term is behind the current term is stale and is
discarded rather than acted upon.

The full set of actions is: elect a new leader under a higher term, emit a
current-term message as leader, apply a pending current-term message, and drop a
stale message.

SAFETY PROPERTY: every in-flight message that claims the current term was emitted
by the current leader, so a message from a deposed leader can never masquerade as
a current-term instruction, even when it arrives out of order.

------------------------------ MODULE W4Od13m2p1t0 ------------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Machines, PerMax

VARIABLES phase, voted, committedCount, ledger

vars == <<phase, voted, committedCount, ledger>>

RECURSIVE SumFn(_, _)
SumFn(f, S) ==
    IF S = {} THEN 0
    ELSE LET x == CHOOSE y \in S : TRUE IN f[x] + SumFn(f, S \ {x})

TypeOK ==
    /\ phase \in [Machines -> {"idle", "preparing", "prepared", "crashed"}]
    /\ voted \in [Machines -> BOOLEAN]
    /\ committedCount \in [Machines -> 0..PerMax]
    /\ ledger \in 0..(Cardinality(Machines) * PerMax)

Init ==
    /\ phase = [m \in Machines |-> "idle"]
    /\ voted = [m \in Machines |-> FALSE]
    /\ committedCount = [m \in Machines |-> 0]
    /\ ledger = 0

\* A vending machine begins reporting one sale to the shared ledger, opening a
\* two-phase commit.
MachinePrepare(m) ==
    /\ phase[m] = "idle"
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![m] = "preparing"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<voted, committedCount, ledger>>

\* The ledger coordinator records its yes vote for the pending sale.
CoordVote(m) ==
    /\ phase[m] = "preparing"
    /\ voted' = [voted EXCEPT ![m] = TRUE]
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![m] = "prepared"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<committedCount, ledger>>

\* Commit atomically records the sale both in the machine's own committed count and
\* in the shared ledger total, so a committed sale is never counted in only one.
Commit(m) ==
    /\ phase[m] = "prepared"
    /\ voted[m]
    /\ committedCount[m] < PerMax
    /\ committedCount' = [committedCount EXCEPT ![m] = committedCount[m] + 1]
    /\ ledger' = ledger + 1
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![m] = "idle"]
    /\ voted' = [voted EXCEPT ![m] = FALSE]

\* An in-flight (uncommitted) transaction is aborted, changing no committed totals.
Abort(m) ==
    /\ phase[m] \in {"preparing", "prepared"}
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![m] = "idle"]
    /\ voted' = [voted EXCEPT ![m] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<committedCount, ledger>>

\* A single machine may crash silently, dropping any transaction it had in flight;
\* nothing already committed is affected.
Crash(m) ==
    /\ \A x \in Machines : phase[x] # "crashed"
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![m] = "crashed"]
    /\ voted' = [voted EXCEPT ![m] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<committedCount, ledger>>

\* A crashed machine recovers to idle; its lost in-flight transaction is simply
\* gone, never having been committed.
Recover(m) ==
    /\ phase[m] = "crashed"
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![m] = "idle"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<voted, committedCount, ledger>>

Next ==
    \/ \E m \in Machines : MachinePrepare(m)
    \/ \E m \in Machines : CoordVote(m)
    \/ \E m \in Machines : Commit(m)
    \/ \E m \in Machines : Abort(m)
    \/ \E m \in Machines : Crash(m)
    \/ \E m \in Machines : Recover(m)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* No lost updates: the shared ledger total always equals the sum of every
\* machine's own committed sale count, so no committed sale is ever dropped from
\* the ledger -- not even when a machine crashes mid-protocol.
NoLostUpdate == ledger = SumFn(committedCount, Machines)

=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Machines = {"m1", "m2"}
    PerMax = 2
SPECIFICATION Spec
INVARIANT NoLostUpdate
nl:
A network of vending machines reports its sales into one shared ledger. Each sale
is recorded with a two-phase commit between the machine and the ledger coordinator
so that a committed sale is never lost, even if a machine crashes silently in the
middle of the protocol.

A machine begins reporting one sale, opening a transaction. The ledger coordinator
records its yes vote for the pending sale. On commit, the sale is recorded
atomically in both the machine's own committed count and the shared ledger total,
so a committed sale never lands in only one of the two. An in-flight, uncommitted
transaction may instead be aborted, changing no committed totals. A single machine
may crash silently at a time, dropping whatever transaction it had in flight;
anything already committed is untouched. A crashed machine later recovers to idle,
its lost in-flight transaction simply gone, never having been committed.

The full set of actions is: begin reporting a sale, record the coordinator's yes
vote, commit a sale atomically into both counts, abort an in-flight transaction,
crash a single machine silently, and recover a crashed machine.

SAFETY PROPERTY: the shared ledger total always equals the sum of every machine's
own committed sale count, so no committed sale is ever dropped from the ledger,
not even when a machine crashes mid-protocol.

------------------------------ MODULE W4Od11m1p3t0 ------------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS NumSpoolers, Printers, Jobs

Spoolers == 1..NumSpoolers
NextOf(s) == (s % NumSpoolers) + 1
NoJob == "no_job"
NoCrash == 0

VARIABLES token, assigned, reserving, crashed

vars == <<token, assigned, reserving, crashed>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ token \in Spoolers
    /\ assigned \in [Printers -> Jobs \union {NoJob}]
    /\ reserving \in [Printers -> Jobs \union {NoJob}]
    /\ crashed \in Spoolers \union {NoCrash}

Init ==
    /\ token = 1
    /\ assigned = [p \in Printers |-> NoJob]
    /\ reserving = [p \in Printers |-> NoJob]
    /\ crashed = NoCrash

\* The spooling token forwards to the next node in the ring, skipping past a node
\* that has crashed silently (the ring auto-advances).
PassToken ==
    /\ token' = NextOf(token)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<assigned, reserving, crashed>>

\* The live token holder reserves a free printer for a job (a tentative claim).
Reserve(p, j) ==
    /\ token # crashed
    /\ assigned[p] = NoJob
    /\ reserving[p] = NoJob
    /\ reserving' = [reserving EXCEPT ![p] = j]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, assigned, crashed>>

\* The live token holder commits a reservation into a firm assignment.
Commit(p) ==
    /\ token # crashed
    /\ reserving[p] # NoJob
    /\ assigned[p] = NoJob
    /\ assigned' = [assigned EXCEPT ![p] = reserving[p]]
    /\ reserving' = [reserving EXCEPT ![p] = NoJob]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, crashed>>

\* The live token holder abandons a tentative reservation.
Abort(p) ==
    /\ token # crashed
    /\ reserving[p] # NoJob
    /\ reserving' = [reserving EXCEPT ![p] = NoJob]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, assigned, crashed>>

\* A finished print job releases its printer.
Complete(p) ==
    /\ assigned[p] # NoJob
    /\ assigned' = [assigned EXCEPT ![p] = NoJob]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, reserving, crashed>>

\* A single spooler node crashes silently.
Crash(s) ==
    /\ crashed = NoCrash
    /\ crashed' = s
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, assigned, reserving>>

\* The crashed node recovers.
Recover ==
    /\ crashed # NoCrash
    /\ crashed' = NoCrash
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, assigned, reserving>>

Next ==
    \/ PassToken
    \/ \E p \in Printers, j \in Jobs : Reserve(p, j)
    \/ \E p \in Printers : Commit(p)
    \/ \E p \in Printers : Abort(p)
    \/ \E p \in Printers : Complete(p)
    \/ \E s \in Spoolers : Crash(s)
    \/ Recover

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* No double allocation: a printer is never simultaneously firmly assigned to one
\* job and tentatively reserved for a different job, so a reservation left dangling
\* by a silent crash can never lead to the same printer being handed to two jobs.
NoDoubleAlloc ==
    \A p \in Printers :
        ~ (assigned[p] # NoJob /\ reserving[p] # NoJob /\ assigned[p] # reserving[p])

=============================================================================
nl:
A print shop job spooler is run by a ring of spooler nodes that pass a single
spooling token around; only the node currently holding the token may assign print
jobs to printers, and a job is assigned in two steps so that a printer is never
handed to two jobs at once -- even if a node crashes silently mid-assignment.

The token forwards to the next node in the ring, automatically skipping past a
node that has crashed silently. The live token holder reserves a free printer for
a job as a tentative claim, then commits that reservation into a firm assignment,
or abandons the reservation. A finished print job releases its printer. A single
spooler node may crash silently at a time and later recover; a reservation left
dangling by the crash still blocks the printer, because a printer that already
carries a tentative reservation cannot be reserved again for another job.

The full set of actions is: pass the token, reserve a free printer for a job,
commit a reservation into a firm assignment, abort a tentative reservation,
complete a finished job to free its printer, crash a spooler node silently, and
recover a crashed node.

SAFETY PROPERTY: a printer is never simultaneously firmly assigned to one job and
tentatively reserved for a different job, so a reservation left dangling by a
silent crash can never lead to the same printer being handed to two jobs.

------------------------------ MODULE W4Od6m9p5t2 ------------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Instances, MaxEpoch, MaxServe

NoEpoch == 0 - 1

VARIABLES epoch, instEpoch, recalled, recallEpoch, armed, lobbyServed

vars == <<epoch, instEpoch, recalled, recallEpoch, armed, lobbyServed>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ epoch \in 0..MaxEpoch
    /\ instEpoch \in [Instances -> 0..MaxEpoch]
    /\ recalled \in BOOLEAN
    /\ recallEpoch \in (0..MaxEpoch) \union {NoEpoch}
    /\ armed \in [Instances -> BOOLEAN]
    /\ lobbyServed \in 0..MaxServe

Init ==
    /\ epoch = 0
    /\ instEpoch = [i \in Instances |-> 0]
    /\ recalled = FALSE
    /\ recallEpoch = NoEpoch
    /\ armed = [i \in Instances |-> FALSE]
    /\ lobbyServed = 0

\* The dispatch policy of the shared car pool is reconfigured under a new epoch,
\* possible only before a fire recall has been committed.
Reconfig ==
    /\ ~ recalled
    /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
    /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<instEpoch, recalled, recallEpoch, armed, lobbyServed>>

\* A controller instance adopts the current dispatch epoch.
Adopt(i) ==
    /\ instEpoch[i] # epoch
    /\ instEpoch' = [instEpoch EXCEPT ![i] = epoch]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, recalled, recallEpoch, armed, lobbyServed>>

\* An instance running the current epoch arms the fire-recall trigger.
Arm(i) ==
    /\ ~ recalled
    /\ instEpoch[i] = epoch
    /\ armed' = [armed EXCEPT ![i] = TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, instEpoch, recalled, recallEpoch, lobbyServed>>

\* An instance stands its trigger back down before any recall fires.
Disarm(i) ==
    /\ ~ recalled
    /\ armed[i]
    /\ armed' = [armed EXCEPT ![i] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, instEpoch, recalled, recallEpoch, lobbyServed>>

\* The irreversible fire recall: an armed, current-epoch instance recalls every car
\* to the lobby and locks the bank down. It can fire at most once because it
\* requires no recall yet, and afterward no reconfiguration can advance the epoch.
Recall(i) ==
    /\ ~ recalled
    /\ instEpoch[i] = epoch
    /\ armed[i]
    /\ recalled' = TRUE
    /\ recallEpoch' = epoch
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, instEpoch, armed, lobbyServed>>

\* After recall the cars ferry occupants to the lobby (ongoing evacuation service).
ServeLobby ==
    /\ recalled
    /\ lobbyServed' = (lobbyServed + 1) % (MaxServe + 1)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, instEpoch, recalled, recallEpoch, armed>>

Next ==
    \/ Reconfig
    \/ \E i \in Instances : Adopt(i)
    \/ \E i \in Instances : Arm(i)
    \/ \E i \in Instances : Disarm(i)
    \/ \E i \in Instances : Recall(i)
    \/ ServeLobby

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* The fire recall is irreversible and happens at most once: once it has fired it is
\* pinned to the epoch it fired under, since no reconfiguration can then advance the
\* epoch, so it can never be superseded or re-fired under a fresh configuration.
RecallPinned ==
    recalled => (recallEpoch = epoch)

=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Instances = {"ctrlA", "ctrlB"}
    MaxEpoch = 2
    MaxServe = 2
SPECIFICATION Spec
INVARIANT RecallPinned
nl:
An elevator bank in a skyscraper is driven by two independent controller instances
that share one common pool of cars. The dispatch policy is managed by
epoch-numbered reconfiguration, and the bank supports one irreversible action: a
fire recall that brings every car to the lobby and locks the bank down, which must
happen at most once.

The shared pool's dispatch policy may be reconfigured under a new epoch, but only
before a recall has been committed. Each controller instance adopts the current
epoch. An instance running the current epoch may arm the fire-recall trigger, and
may stand it back down before any recall fires. The irreversible recall fires when
an armed, current-epoch instance commits it: it requires that no recall has yet
occurred, and once it fires the epoch is frozen so no further reconfiguration can
occur. After recall, the cars ferry occupants to the lobby as ongoing evacuation
service.

The full set of actions is: reconfigure the dispatch policy under a new epoch
before recall, adopt the current epoch on an instance, arm a recall trigger,
disarm a recall trigger, commit the irreversible fire recall, and serve the lobby
after recall.

SAFETY PROPERTY: once the fire recall has fired it is pinned to the epoch it fired
under, since no reconfiguration can then advance the epoch, so it can never be
superseded or re-fired under a fresh configuration.

------------------------------ MODULE W4Od4m5p6t5 ------------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Stations, Quorum, MaxRound, MaxAdv, MaxOv

NoVote == 0 - 1

VARIABLES round, votes, advanced, overrides

vars == <<round, votes, advanced, overrides>>

CurrentVotes == Cardinality({s \in Stations : votes[s] = round})

TypeOK ==
    /\ round \in 0..MaxRound
    /\ votes \in [Stations -> (0..MaxRound) \union {NoVote}]
    /\ advanced \in 0..MaxAdv
    /\ overrides \in 0..MaxOv

Init ==
    /\ round = 0
    /\ votes = [s \in Stations |-> NoVote]
    /\ advanced = 0
    /\ overrides = 0

\* A conveyor station casts its vote to advance the line this round.
Vote(s) ==
    /\ votes[s] # round
    /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![s] = round]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<round, advanced, overrides>>

\* A station retracts its vote before the line advances.
Unvote(s) ==
    /\ votes[s] = round
    /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![s] = NoVote]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<round, advanced, overrides>>

\* The line advances only when a quorum of this round's votes approves. Advancing
\* opens a new round and clears every vote, so no vote can carry over.
Advance ==
    /\ round < MaxRound
    /\ CurrentVotes >= Quorum
    /\ advanced' = (advanced + 1) % (MaxAdv + 1)
    /\ round' = round + 1
    /\ votes' = [s \in Stations |-> NoVote]
    /\ UNCHANGED overrides

\* A privileged supervisor force-advances the line, bypassing the quorum, but still
\* opens a new round and clears every vote.
AdminOverride ==
    /\ round < MaxRound
    /\ advanced' = (advanced + 1) % (MaxAdv + 1)
    /\ round' = round + 1
    /\ votes' = [s \in Stations |-> NoVote]
    /\ overrides' = (overrides + 1) % (MaxOv + 1)

Next ==
    \/ \E s \in Stations : Vote(s)
    \/ \E s \in Stations : Unvote(s)
    \/ Advance
    \/ AdminOverride

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* No action by an unauthorized or stale participant: every station's recorded vote
\* is either absent or stamped for the current round, so no vote left over from an
\* earlier round can ever survive to help authorize the next conveyor advance.
FreshVotesOnly ==
    \A s \in Stations : votes[s] \in {NoVote, round}

=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Stations = {"s1", "s2", "s3"}
    Quorum = 2
    MaxRound = 3
    MaxAdv = 2
    MaxOv = 2
SPECIFICATION Spec
INVARIANT FreshVotesOnly
nl:
A car-wash conveyor line advances one bay per round, and each advance must be
authorized by quorum voting among the line's safety stations. To make sure no
stale or unauthorized approval ever moves the line, votes are stamped with the
round they were cast for, and every advance opens a fresh round and clears all
votes so that nothing carries over.

A station casts its vote to advance the line this round, and may retract that vote
before the line advances. The line advances only when a quorum of the current
round's votes approves; advancing opens a new round and clears every vote. A
