------------------------------ MODULE W4Od5m0p4t2 ------------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Instances, Capacity

NoSnap == 0 - 1

VARIABLES players, spectators, snap, kind

vars == <<players, spectators, snap, kind>>

Occupancy == players + spectators

TypeOK ==
    /\ players \in 0..Capacity
    /\ spectators \in 0..Capacity
    /\ snap \in [Instances -> (0..Capacity) \union {NoSnap}]
    /\ kind \in [Instances -> {"player", "spectator", "idle"}]

Init ==
    /\ players = 0
    /\ spectators = 0
    /\ snap = [i \in Instances |-> NoSnap]
    /\ kind = [i \in Instances |-> "idle"]

\* A matchmaker instance optimistically reads the shared occupancy and records what
\* it intends to add (a player or a spectator).
Read(i, k) ==
    /\ snap[i] = NoSnap
    /\ snap' = [snap EXCEPT ![i] = Occupancy]
    /\ kind' = [kind EXCEPT ![i] = k]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<players, spectators>>

\* The instance commits its add only if the occupancy is unchanged since its read
\* (optimistic check) and there is genuine room (capacity check).
Commit(i) ==
    /\ snap[i] # NoSnap
    /\ Occupancy = snap[i]
    /\ Occupancy < Capacity
    /\ players' = IF kind[i] = "player" THEN players + 1 ELSE players
    /\ spectators' = IF kind[i] = "spectator" THEN spectators + 1 ELSE spectators
    /\ snap' = [snap EXCEPT ![i] = NoSnap]
    /\ kind' = [kind EXCEPT ![i] = "idle"]

\* If the occupancy changed under it (another instance raced ahead), the instance
\* discards its stale read and must retry.
Retry(i) ==
    /\ snap[i] # NoSnap
    /\ Occupancy # snap[i]
    /\ snap' = [snap EXCEPT ![i] = NoSnap]
    /\ kind' = [kind EXCEPT ![i] = "idle"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<players, spectators>>

\* A player leaves the lobby, freeing capacity.
LeavePlayer ==
    /\ players > 0
    /\ players' = players - 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<spectators, snap, kind>>

\* A spectator leaves the lobby, freeing capacity.
LeaveSpectator ==
    /\ spectators > 0
    /\ spectators' = spectators - 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<players, snap, kind>>

Next ==
    \/ \E i \in Instances, k \in {"player", "spectator"} : Read(i, k)
    \/ \E i \in Instances : Commit(i)
    \/ \E i \in Instances : Retry(i)
    \/ LeavePlayer
    \/ LeaveSpectator

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Bounded capacity: the combined count of players and spectators in the shared
\* lobby never exceeds its capacity, even though two matchmaker instances commit
\* joins concurrently against the one pool.
WithinCapacity == players + spectators <= Capacity

    /\ occupant \in Drones \union {NoOne}

    /\ round \in 0..MaxRound

Init ==
    /\ occupant = NoOne
    /\ granted = [v \in Voters |-> NoOne]

\* A drone campaigns for exclusive use of the shared airspace corridor.
Campaign(d) ==
    /\ occupant = NoOne
    /\ d \notin campaigning
    /\ campaigning' = campaigning \union {d}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<occupant, granted, round>>

\* A swarm voter grants its single vote to a campaigning drone.
Grant(v, d) ==
    /\ occupant = NoOne
    /\ d \in campaigning
    /\ granted[v] = NoOne
    /\ granted' = [granted EXCEPT ![v] = d]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<occupant, campaigning, round>>

\* A drone with a quorum of grants enters the corridor, taking exclusive occupancy.
Enter(d) ==
    /\ occupant = NoOne
    /\ d \in campaigning
    /\ Tally(d) >= Quorum
    /\ occupant' = d
    /\ UNCHANGED <<granted, campaigning, round>>

    /\ occupant = d
    /\ occupant' = NoOne
    /\ granted' = [v \in Voters |-> NoOne]
    /\ campaigning' = {}
    /\ round' = (round + 1) % (MaxRound + 1)

\* A deadlocked election (no drone reaching quorum) times out and restarts.

    /\ occupant = NoOne
    /\ granted' = [v \in Voters |-> NoOne]
    /\ campaigning' = {}
    /\ round' = (round + 1) % (MaxRound + 1)
    /\ UNCHANGED occupant

    \/ \E v \in Voters, d \in Drones : Grant(v, d)
    \/ \E d \in Drones : Enter(d)
    \/ \E d \in Drones : Exit(d)

\* corridor was elected by a quorum of the swarm's voters, so no drone can ever
\* seize the critical corridor without genuine quorum backing.

------------------------------ MODULE W4Od1m5p0t0 ------------------------------

CONSTANTS Aircraft, Controllers, Quorum

NoOne == "no_one"

vars == <<occupant, onRunway, granted, crashed>>

LiveTally(a) == Cardinality({c \in Controllers : granted[c] = a /\ c # crashed})

    /\ occupant \in Aircraft \union {NoOne}
    /\ onRunway \in SUBSET Aircraft
    /\ granted \in [Controllers -> Aircraft \union {NoOne}]
    /\ crashed \in Controllers \union {NoOne}

Init ==
    /\ occupant = NoOne
    /\ onRunway = {}
    /\ granted = [c \in Controllers |-> NoOne]
    /\ crashed = NoOne

\* A live controller grants its clearance vote to an aircraft awaiting the runway.
Grant(c, a) ==
    /\ occupant = NoOne
    /\ c # crashed
    /\ granted[c] = NoOne
    /\ granted' = [granted EXCEPT ![c] = a]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<occupant, onRunway, crashed>>

\* An aircraft with a quorum of live controllers' votes is cleared onto the runway.
Clear(a) ==
    /\ occupant = NoOne
    /\ LiveTally(a) >= Quorum
    /\ occupant' = a
    /\ UNCHANGED <<onRunway, granted, crashed>>

\* The cleared aircraft physically rolls onto the runway, only if the runway is
\* empty -- and only the aircraft that actually holds clearance.
RollOnto(a) ==
    /\ occupant = a
    /\ onRunway = {}
    /\ onRunway' = {a}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<occupant, granted, crashed>>

\* The aircraft rolls off the runway.
RollOff(a) ==
    /\ a \in onRunway
    /\ onRunway' = onRunway \ {a}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<occupant, granted, crashed>>

\* Clearance is released once the aircraft is off, resetting votes for the next.
Release(a) ==
    /\ occupant = a
    /\ a \notin onRunway
    /\ occupant' = NoOne
    /\ granted' = [c \in Controllers |-> NoOne]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<onRunway, crashed>>

\* A single controller crashes silently.
Crash(c) ==
    /\ crashed = NoOne
    /\ crashed' = c
    /\ UNCHANGED <<occupant, onRunway, granted>>

\* The crashed controller recovers.
Recover ==
    /\ crashed # NoOne
    /\ crashed' = NoOne
    /\ UNCHANGED <<occupant, onRunway, granted>>

Next ==
    \/ \E c \in Controllers, a \in Aircraft : Grant(c, a)
    \/ \E a \in Aircraft : Clear(a)
    \/ \E a \in Aircraft : RollOnto(a)
    \/ \E a \in Aircraft : RollOff(a)
    \/ \E a \in Aircraft : Release(a)
    \/ \E c \in Controllers : Crash(c)
    \/ Recover

\* Mutual exclusion of the runway: the set of aircraft physically on the runway is
\* always contained in the singleton of the currently-cleared occupant (empty when
\* none is cleared), so two aircraft can never be on the one runway at once.
RunwayExclusive ==
    onRunway \subseteq (IF occupant = NoOne THEN {} ELSE {occupant})

An air-traffic runway allocator controls a single runway, a critical resource that
only one aircraft may occupy at a time. Clearance onto the runway is decided by
quorum voting among the tower controllers, and the protocol tolerates one
controller crashing silently: a quorum of the remaining live controllers still
suffices to clear an aircraft.

A live controller grants its clearance vote to an aircraft awaiting the runway. An
aircraft that has collected a quorum of live controllers' votes is cleared onto
the runway. The cleared aircraft then physically rolls onto the runway, but only
if the runway is empty and only the aircraft that actually holds clearance. The
aircraft later rolls off, and clearance is released once it is off, resetting the
votes for the next aircraft. A single controller may crash silently at a time and
later recover; a crashed controller's vote does not count toward a quorum.

The full set of actions is: grant a live controller's vote, clear an aircraft on a
live quorum, roll the cleared aircraft onto an empty runway, roll it off, release
clearance once it is off, crash a controller silently, and recover a crashed
controller.

SAFETY PROPERTY: the set of aircraft physically on the runway is always contained
in the singleton of the currently-cleared occupant, empty when none is cleared, so
two aircraft can never be on the one runway at once.

------------------------------ MODULE W4Od0m3p3t5 ------------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Schedulers, Slots, Surgeries, MaxTerm

NoOne == "no_one"
NoTerm == 0 - 1

VARIABLES term, leader, booked, proposing, proposeTerm

vars == <<term, leader, booked, proposing, proposeTerm>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ term \in 0..MaxTerm
    /\ leader \in Schedulers \union {NoOne}
    /\ booked \in [Slots -> Surgeries \union {NoOne}]
    /\ proposing \in [Slots -> Surgeries \union {NoOne}]
    /\ proposeTerm \in [Slots -> (0..MaxTerm) \union {NoTerm}]

Init ==
    /\ term = 0
    /\ leader = NoOne
    /\ booked = [s \in Slots |-> NoOne]
    /\ proposing = [s \in Slots |-> NoOne]
    /\ proposeTerm = [s \in Slots |-> NoTerm]

\* A scheduler wins a failover election under a fresh, higher term and becomes the
\* booking leader; any earlier leader's outstanding proposals are now stale.
Elect(s) ==
    /\ term < MaxTerm
    /\ term' = term + 1
    /\ leader' = s
    /\ UNCHANGED <<booked, proposing, proposeTerm>>

\* The leader proposes booking a free slot for a surgery, stamping the proposal
\* with the current term.
Propose(sl, surg) ==
    /\ leader # NoOne
    /\ booked[sl] = NoOne
    /\ proposing[sl] = NoOne
    /\ proposing' = [proposing EXCEPT ![sl] = surg]
    /\ proposeTerm' = [proposeTerm EXCEPT ![sl] = term]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<term, leader, booked>>

\* A proposal made under the current term is confirmed into a firm booking.
Confirm(sl) ==
    /\ proposing[sl] # NoOne
    /\ proposeTerm[sl] = term
    /\ booked[sl] = NoOne
    /\ booked' = [booked EXCEPT ![sl] = proposing[sl]]
    /\ proposing' = [proposing EXCEPT ![sl] = NoOne]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<term, leader, proposeTerm>>

\* A proposal left over from a deposed leader (stamped with an old term) is dropped.
StaleWithdraw(sl) ==
    /\ proposing[sl] # NoOne
    /\ proposeTerm[sl] # term
    /\ proposing' = [proposing EXCEPT ![sl] = NoOne]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<term, leader, booked, proposeTerm>>

\* A completed surgery frees its slot.
Complete(sl) ==
    /\ booked[sl] # NoOne
    /\ booked' = [booked EXCEPT ![sl] = NoOne]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<term, leader, proposing, proposeTerm>>

\* The chief of surgery force-books a slot, clearing any pending proposal so no
\* conflicting claim can linger behind the override.
AdminOverride(sl, surg) ==
    /\ booked' = [booked EXCEPT ![sl] = surg]
    /\ proposing' = [proposing EXCEPT ![sl] = NoOne]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<term, leader, proposeTerm>>

Next ==
    \/ \E s \in Schedulers : Elect(s)
    \/ \E sl \in Slots, surg \in Surgeries : Propose(sl, surg)
    \/ \E sl \in Slots : Confirm(sl)
    \/ \E sl \in Slots : StaleWithdraw(sl)
    \/ \E sl \in Slots : Complete(sl)
    \/ \E sl \in Slots, surg \in Surgeries : AdminOverride(sl, surg)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* No double allocation: a slot is never simultaneously firmly booked for one
\* surgery and carrying a pending proposal for a different one, so a proposal left
\* over across a failover can never lead to the same slot being handed to two
\* surgeries.
NoDoubleAlloc ==
    \A sl \in Slots :
        ~ (booked[sl] # NoOne /\ proposing[sl] # NoOne /\ booked[sl] # proposing[sl])

=============================================================================
nl:
A hospital operating-room scheduler books surgeries into OR slots under a single
booking leader, elected among the schedulers with failover when the leader is
lost. Bookings are made in two steps -- propose then confirm -- and proposals are
stamped with the leader's term, so that a proposal left over from a deposed leader
across a failover can never cause the same slot to be handed to two surgeries.

A scheduler wins a failover election under a fresh, higher term and becomes the
booking leader; any earlier leader's outstanding proposals are now stale. The
leader proposes booking a free slot for a surgery, stamping the proposal with the
current term. A proposal made under the current term is confirmed into a firm
booking, while a proposal stamped with an old term is dropped as stale. A
completed surgery frees its slot. Finally, the chief of surgery may force-book a
slot, clearing any pending proposal so no conflicting claim can linger behind the
override.

The full set of actions is: elect a new leader under a higher term, propose a
booking on a free slot, confirm a current-term proposal, withdraw a stale proposal,
complete a surgery to free its slot, and perform a privileged chief override.

SAFETY PROPERTY: a slot is never simultaneously firmly booked for one surgery and
carrying a pending proposal for a different one, so a proposal left over across a
failover can never lead to the same slot being handed to two surgeries.

------------------------------ MODULE W4Od13m8p0t1 ------------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Clients, Machines, Trays

NoOne == "no_one"
NoMachine == "no_machine"
NoTray == "no_tray"

VARIABLES coarseHolder, fineHolder, phase, loc, tray

vars == <<coarseHolder, fineHolder, phase, loc, tray>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ coarseHolder \in [Machines -> Clients \union {NoOne}]
    /\ fineHolder \in [Machines -> [Trays -> Clients \union {NoOne}]]
    /\ phase \in [Clients -> {"idle", "coarseHeld", "inCS"}]
    /\ loc \in [Clients -> Machines \union {NoMachine}]
    /\ tray \in [Clients -> Trays \union {NoTray}]

Init ==
    /\ coarseHolder = [m \in Machines |-> NoOne]
    /\ fineHolder = [m \in Machines |-> [t \in Trays |-> NoOne]]
    /\ phase = [c \in Clients |-> "idle"]
    /\ loc = [c \in Clients |-> NoMachine]
    /\ tray = [c \in Clients |-> NoTray]

\* A restocker first takes a machine's coarse lock (top of the hierarchy). Each
\* machine's coarse lock is exclusive, but different machines can be worked at once.
AcquireCoarse(c, m) ==
    /\ phase[c] = "idle"
    /\ coarseHolder[m] = NoOne
    /\ coarseHolder' = [coarseHolder EXCEPT ![m] = c]
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![c] = "coarseHeld"]
    /\ loc' = [loc EXCEPT ![c] = m]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<fineHolder, tray>>

\* Holding that machine's coarse lock, the restocker takes a free tray's fine lock
\* on the same machine and enters its critical section.
AcquireFine(c, t) ==
    /\ phase[c] = "coarseHeld"
    /\ coarseHolder[loc[c]] = c
    /\ fineHolder[loc[c]][t] = NoOne
    /\ fineHolder' = [fineHolder EXCEPT ![loc[c]][t] = c]
    /\ tray' = [tray EXCEPT ![c] = t]
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![c] = "inCS"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarseHolder, loc>>

\* Leaving the critical section releases both the fine tray lock and the coarse
\* machine lock together.
Release(c) ==
    /\ phase[c] = "inCS"
    /\ coarseHolder' = [coarseHolder EXCEPT ![loc[c]] = NoOne]
    /\ fineHolder' = [fineHolder EXCEPT ![loc[c]][tray[c]] = NoOne]
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![c] = "idle"]
    /\ loc' = [loc EXCEPT ![c] = NoMachine]
    /\ tray' = [tray EXCEPT ![c] = NoTray]

\* A restocker may give up a machine's coarse lock before taking any tray lock.
ReleaseCoarse(c) ==
    /\ phase[c] = "coarseHeld"
    /\ coarseHolder' = [coarseHolder EXCEPT ![loc[c]] = NoOne]
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![c] = "idle"]
    /\ loc' = [loc EXCEPT ![c] = NoMachine]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<fineHolder, tray>>

Next ==
    \/ \E c \in Clients, m \in Machines : AcquireCoarse(c, m)
    \/ \E c \in Clients, t \in Trays : AcquireFine(c, t)
    \/ \E c \in Clients : Release(c)
    \/ \E c \in Clients : ReleaseCoarse(c)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Mutual exclusion via the lock hierarchy: on any machine, whoever holds one of its
\* tray (fine) locks also holds that machine's exclusive coarse lock, so only the
\* single coarse-lock holder can service that machine's trays -- two restockers can
\* never service the same machine's trays at once.
HierarchyRespected ==
    \A m \in Machines, t \in Trays :
        (fineHolder[m][t] # NoOne) => (coarseHolder[m] = fineHolder[m][t])

=============================================================================
nl:
A vending machine network is serviced by restockers who take hierarchical locks:
to work on a tray they must first hold that machine's coarse machine-wide lock,
and only then may they take a fine tray lock. Each machine's coarse lock is
exclusive, though different machines may be serviced at the same time. Restockers'
requests arrive over a network that may interleave and reorder them arbitrarily,
so the protocol is designed so that two restockers can never service the same
machine's trays at once.

A restocker first takes a machine's coarse lock; each machine's coarse lock admits
only one holder, but two restockers may hold the coarse locks of two different
machines concurrently. Holding a machine's coarse lock, the restocker takes a free
tray's fine lock on that same machine and enters its critical section to service
the tray. Leaving the critical section releases both the fine tray lock and the
coarse machine lock together. A restocker may also give up a coarse lock before
ever taking a tray lock.

The full set of actions is: acquire a machine's exclusive coarse lock, acquire a
free tray's fine lock on the held machine and enter the critical section, release
both locks on leaving the critical section, and release a coarse lock early.

SAFETY PROPERTY: on any machine, whoever holds one of its tray fine locks also
holds that machine's exclusive coarse lock, so only the single coarse-lock holder
can service that machine's trays and two restockers can never service the same
machine's trays at once.

------------------------------ MODULE W4Od19m5p0t3 ------------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Members, Patrons, Quorum

NoOne == "no_one"

VARIABLES holder, granted, requesting, slow

vars == <<holder, granted, requesting, slow>>

Tally(p) == Cardinality({mb \in Members : granted[mb] = p})

TypeOK ==
    /\ holder \in Patrons \union {NoOne}
    /\ granted \in [Members -> Patrons \union {NoOne}]
    /\ requesting \in SUBSET Patrons
    /\ slow \in [Members -> BOOLEAN]

Init ==
    /\ holder = NoOne
    /\ granted = [mb \in Members |-> NoOne]
    /\ requesting = {}
    /\ slow = [mb \in Members |-> FALSE]

\* A patron requests the single rare book.
Request(p) ==
    /\ holder = NoOne
    /\ p \notin requesting
    /\ requesting' = requesting \union {p}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, granted, slow>>

\* A committee member that is responsive (not slow) grants its vote to a requester.
Grant(mb, p) ==
    /\ holder = NoOne
    /\ ~ slow[mb]
    /\ p \in requesting
    /\ granted[mb] = NoOne
    /\ granted' = [granted EXCEPT ![mb] = p]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, requesting, slow>>

\* A committee member becomes slow (backlogged) -- it is not failed and its
\* already-cast vote is retained; it simply cannot cast new votes until it resumes.
Slow(mb) ==
    /\ ~ slow[mb]
    /\ slow' = [slow EXCEPT ![mb] = TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, granted, requesting>>

Resume(mb) ==
    /\ slow[mb]
    /\ slow' = [slow EXCEPT ![mb] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, granted, requesting>>

\* A patron backed by a quorum of grants is awarded exclusive hold of the book.
Award(p) ==
    /\ holder = NoOne
    /\ Tally(p) >= Quorum
    /\ holder' = p
    /\ UNCHANGED <<granted, requesting, slow>>

\* The holder returns the book, resetting the committee for the next round.
Return(p) ==
    /\ holder = p
    /\ holder' = NoOne
    /\ granted' = [mb \in Members |-> NoOne]
    /\ requesting' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED slow

Next ==
    \/ \E p \in Patrons : Request(p)
    \/ \E mb \in Members, p \in Patrons : Grant(mb, p)
    \/ \E mb \in Members : Slow(mb)
    \/ \E mb \in Members : Resume(mb)
    \/ \E p \in Patrons : Award(p)
    \/ \E p \in Patrons : Return(p)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Mutual exclusion via quorum: whichever patron exclusively holds the rare book was
\* awarded it by a quorum of committee grants, so no patron can ever seize the one
\* book without genuine quorum backing -- and a slow member never loses its vote.
HolderHasQuorum ==
    (holder # NoOne) => (Tally(holder) >= Quorum)

=============================================================================
nl:
A library book reservation system controls access to a single rare book, a
critical resource only one patron may hold at a time. Access is decided by quorum
voting among a reservation committee, and the system tolerates a committee member
that is slow but not failed: a backlogged member simply cannot cast new votes
until it catches up, but the votes it has already cast are never lost.

A patron requests the single rare book. A committee member that is responsive
grants its vote to a requester. A member may become slow (backlogged); it is not
failed, its already-cast vote is retained, and it merely cannot cast new votes
until it resumes. A patron backed by a quorum of grants is awarded exclusive hold
of the book. When the holder returns the book, the committee resets for the next
round, clearing all grants and requests.

The full set of actions is: request the book, grant a responsive member's vote,
mark a member slow, resume a slow member, award the book to a patron with a
quorum, and return the book.

SAFETY PROPERTY: whichever patron exclusively holds the rare book was awarded it
by a quorum of committee grants, so no patron can ever seize the one book without
genuine quorum backing.
